name: Aura of Experience needs a level 60 character on the realm
contract: Item 818059 Aura of Experience is refused, and kept, while no character on the account has reached level 60, as its CoA tooltip states (This item requires you to have a level 60 on this realm to be able to consume). A level 59 character on the account is not enough. Once another character of the account is saved at level 60, the same alt consumes one item and receives aura 818059.

steps.label: A level 59 character on the account does not unlock the aura
The refused use answers SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT beside the tooltip text
A saved level 60 character on the account unlocks the aura
